outcome.Summary: Implemented `Parse(args []string) (Config, error)` in `cli/cli.go` as a hand-rolled parser (no `flag` package): handles `-v`/`--verbose` (repeatable, clusterable like `-vv`), `-n`/`--count` (space, `=`, and attached forms; default 1; non-integer or negative → error), `-o`/`--output` (default `"-"`), repeatable `--tag` appending to `Tags` in order (nil when absent), `--` terminator (everything after is positional), lone `-` as positional, and unknown flags. All errors wrap `ErrUsage` via `%w` and name the offending flag. Verified with a temporary comprehensive spec/error test (since removed — existing `cli_test.go` untouched); `go build`, `go vet`, and `go test ./... -count=1` all pass.
